# Lunar Client

> > Lunar Client is a free all-in-one modpack and client for Minecraft: Java Edition that enhances gameplay with performance optimizations, mods, cosmetics, and creator tools.

Lunar Client supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, offering built-in mods like WAILA, Minimap, and Bedwars Mod alongside features for content creators. The platform provides Minecraft utilities including server tools, head explorers, and customization generators.

## Key Topics

- Lunar Client
- Minecraft: Java Edition
- Minecraft mods and modpacks
- WAILA (What Am I Looking At)
- Minimap Mod
- Bedwars Mod
- Minecraft Head Format (MHF)
- Custom heads and player heads
- Content creator tools
- Server utilities
- Cosmetics and emotes
- Bedrock Edition compatibility
- Vanilla Launching
- Performance optimization
- Cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux)

## Minecraft Tools & Utilities

- [Server Pinger for Minecraft](https://www.lunarclient.com/tools/server-pinger): Check Minecraft server status for Java & Bedrock Edition
- [Totem Generator for Minecraft 1.18](https://www.lunarclient.com/tools/totem-generator/minecraft-1.18): Generate custom totems for Minecraft 1.18 using your own skin
- [Minecraft Color Codes](https://www.lunarclient.com/tools/color-codes): Minecraft Java Edition color codes reference for chat and MOTD formatting
